title: Cablear human-time ledger a Primary Chat y scale-readiness
mission: Connect the verified deterministic human-time ledger to the existing durable human/action/boundary event producers and existing Primary Chat / scale-readiness projections, without creating a new event store, authority owner or scheduler.
definition_of_done: Identify the existing durable HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED, HUMAN_ACTION_OBSERVED and boundary-clear event producers used by current owners.
Feed those existing events into scripts/human-time-ledger-v1.mjs without duplicating storage or authority.
Expose deterministic human_bottleneck and human_touch_budget fields through the existing Primary Chat and scale-readiness projections.
Verify worker signals do not reset the human clock and external unobserved conversations keep null duration.

semantic_identity.target: existing primary chat and scale-readiness human-time consumers
acceptance: existing durable human action and boundary events feed the deterministic ledger without a new storage owner
primary chat and scale-readiness expose derived human_bottleneck and human_touch_budget from durable events
